title: A/R Detail: a new as-of date with one location left hides the chip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in A/R Detail on today's date at two locations, location A and location B.
  • Pick an earlier date, date A, on which all of the organization's open A/R documents were at location A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick location A.
  2. Change the as-of date to date A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chip reads "Location: " and location B's name.

Step 2:

  • The report reloads for date A.
  • Rows from location A are listed: location B is not in the list for date A, so the filter returns to every location.
  • The Location chip is not shown: the list for date A holds only location A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-E3: “Changing the as-of date keeps every ticked location that is still in the new list (S5-R3). If none of the ticked locations is still in the list, the filter returns to All locations, and the chip reads "Location: All locations", unless the new list holds only one location, in which case the chip is hidden (S5-N1). A user who chose No locations keeps No locations.”
  • S5-N1: “If the organization's open documents sit at only one location and it is ticked, the Location chip is not shown.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design pictures the Location chip but not a date whose list holds one location (all 7 boards checked); the case follows the PRD.
